data.narrative:
Grain Weevil is a seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company founded by Chad and Ben Johnson that has raised $3.5M to date. The valuation universe comprises eight private robotics and manufacturing firms, including peers such as Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, and Bedrock Robotics, alongside one public comparable (ticker 277810.KQ).

The Stage-Progression method is applicable and forms the primary valuation vector. Using total capital raised ($3.5M) as a baseline proxy and applying a typical 2.5x multiplier for progression from Seed to the next financing stage yields an implied valuation of $9M. The Peer-Median method is not applicable due to insufficient data density: while eight same-sector peers exist in the broader Robotics & Manufacturing universe, filtering for same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-valuation-tier comparables yielded fewer than three datapoints, rendering sector-wide medians unreliably broad.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $7M (low) to $10M (high), with a median point of $9M. This range reflects the single applicable method and carries material uncertainty stemming from limited peer comparability at the seed stage and the absence of narrowly-filtered comparable transaction data. Key sensitivities include the propriety of the 2.5x step-up multiplier for this company's specific risk profile and market conditions, as well as the stage at which the next financing round is expected.
